capabilities: capture the desktop or app windows with microphone narration
record audio-only voice memos as .webm files
embed recordings into the active note at the cursor
configure save folder and quality profiles
extras: Naming is inconsistent in the README: the plugin is called Media Recorder, but the manual-install folder is obsidian-media-journal and several sections refer to 'Media Journal'. Installation from Community Plugins is marked 'Once Approved' and the manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice.
motivation: The README says it streamlines the capture workflow for daily study reviews, practical labs, and audio diaries without cluttering the system with third-party recording software.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in video or screen recording, so capturing media for notes requires third-party recording software outside the vault.
summary: Dockable in-app recorder that captures webcam video, screen captures, and audio-only voice memos directly into vault notes.
